integrity: The proof uses Chen's exact orbit-distance formula, a self-contained strict-convexity calculation, and the real Schur-Horn theorem for existence of constant-diagonal projections. The minimizer classification is derived from equality in both the projection bound and Jensen's inequality. Finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes only distances from the identity correlation matrix to rank-bounded strata, using the ambient default metric d_orb,n. It does not solve arbitrary pairwise distance alignment, and it does not address the distinct smaller-ambient metrics d_orb,k. An equivalent identity may exist under uncommon frame-geometric terminology despite the targeted searches.
title: Closed-form distance from the identity to every rank stratum of Chen's correlation orbit space
